pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)fire aspect, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Furnace or Campfire or Soul Campfire$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Furnace or Campfire or Soul Campfire$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#seating)any seating$(/l) or $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#furnishing)any furnishing$(/l)$(li)Lava$(li)Magma Block$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)Water$(li)any crops
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Seating surrounds fire, and light is 1-6 from fire.
